canonical_body_policy: All original title/sections/numbered lines unchanged. PST/PDT and punctuation errors remain literal, accompanied by warnings.
method: Source-only complete article review for passing sources; identity/opening review for rejected sources. No target outcomes or postgame sources opened. Actual replay/Memento/hash, independent prior records and official scheduled wall-clock validated separately.
